start.permissionDenied: Location access denied. Allow location for Walkedia in your phone settings, then restart the app.
start.timeout: Timed out getting your position. Try again (the first GPS fix can be slow indoors).
start.positionUnavailable: Position unavailable. Check that location is enabled on your phone and try again, ideally outdoors.
start.slowServersHint: Public OpenStreetMap servers can be slow. The first load of an area you have never visited can take up to a minute; later loads are instant.
start.permissionDeniedBody: Location access is denied for this app. Enable it in your phone settings to resume recording. Your progress is untouched.
start.zoneErrorTitle: This area could not be loaded.
start.zoneErrorBody: Already loaded neighborhoods stay visible, and your progress is untouched. Try again in a moment.

account.notConfigured: Account not configured — fill in mobile/.env from .env.example to enable sign-in.

login.subtitle: Sign in to continue
login.magicLinkSent: Sign-in link sent to {{email}}. Open it from this phone.
login.notConfiguredBody: Fill in mobile/.env from .env.example to enable sign-in — it is the only way into the app.
login.slogan: A new adventure is always close by

profile.title: Profile
profile.backgroundTrackingLabel: Detect my walks even when the app is closed
profile.backgroundTrackingDesc: Uses your location in the background ("Always" permission) to offer to import your walks when you return to the app. Off by default.
profile.noNeighborhoods: No neighborhoods mapped in the loaded areas yet.
profile.untrackedNote: {{count}} point(s) earned before time tracking started: counted in the total only.
profile.restartForRtl: Close and reopen the app so the layout fully adapts to this language.
profile.colorDesc: Replaces the purple for the halo around intersections, already validated points, and your session track.
profile.avatarDesc: Also replaces your position marker on the map.

search.title: Leaderboard
search.loginPrompt: Sign in (Profile tab) to see the leaderboard and manage your friends.

leaderboard.addFriendsPrompt: Add friends to see their ranking.
leaderboard.emptyBody: Walkedia is better compared with others: everyone maps their own neighborhood, and you see who is moving fastest.

friends.searchPlaceholder: Search for a player by username…
friends.noFriendsYet: No friends yet — search for a username above.

toast.tooZoomedOut: Too zoomed out to load new areas.
toast.walkImported: Walk imported: {{edges}} new segment(s), {{junctions}} intersection(s) completed.
toast.sessionStoppedSpeed: Session stopped: too fast ({{speed}} km/h) for walking.
toast.zoneNotLoadedYet: Area not loaded yet — the session will start as soon as the network is there.
toast.sessionEnded: Session ended ({{minutes}} min): {{edges}} new segment(s), {{junctions}} intersection(s) completed.
toast.notEnoughNetwork: Not enough loaded network to simulate.

alert.walkDetectedBody:

Import this walk into your history?

settings.bgTrackingTitle: Detect my walks outside the app
settings.bgTrackingDesc: Walkedia records your routes in the background and offers to import them when you return. Turn it off whenever you like.
settings.autoStopDesc: Above 20 km/h, the session stops on its own. Turn this off if fast downhill walking triggers it by mistake.
settings.noAccount: No account: your record stays on this device.
settings.wipeConfirmDesc: This cannot be undone. Tap again to confirm.
settings.wipeDesc: Removes streets, points, and sessions, on the device and the account.
